{'text': 'One of the best AI-powered dictation apps for Mac just got another upgrade, with a major new update bringing a redesigned transcript editor and notable performance improvements. Details below.', 'zh': '適用於 Mac 的最佳 AI 驅動聽寫應用程式之一再度升級，最新重大更新帶來重新設計的逐字稿編輯器以及顯著的效能改進。詳情如下。'}

{'text': 'MacWhisper 14 launches', 'zh': 'MacWhisper 14 正式登場'}

{'text': 'If you’re not familiar with MacWhisper, it’s an excellent app from prolific indie developer Jordi Bruin.', 'zh': '如果你還不認識 MacWhisper，這是由多產獨立開發者 Jordi Bruin 推出的一款出色應用程式。'}

{'text': 'It lets users quickly and easily transcribe audio, video, meetings, and system audio on the Mac itself using locally running AI models, including OpenAI’s Whisper and Nvidia’s blazing-fast Parakeet.', 'zh': '它讓用戶可以直接在 Mac 上，利用本地運行的 AI 模型（包括 OpenAI 的 Whisper 及 Nvidia 速度極快的 Parakeet），快速輕鬆地轉錄音訊、影片、會議內容及系統聲音。'}

{'text': 'I use it daily for both pre- and post-production on my podcast, and it comes highly recommended.', 'zh': '我在製作播客的前期與後期流程中，每日都會用到它，實在值得大力推薦。'}

{'text': 'Since MacWhisper’s launch in 2023, Bruin has continued to expand its capabilities, streamline the workflow, and deliver a number of welcome performance improvements.', 'zh': '自 2023 年推出 MacWhisper 以來，Bruin 持續擴展其功能、精簡操作流程，並帶來不少令人欣喜的效能提升。'}

{'text': 'MacWhisper 14 continues in that direction with a redesigned editor, faster performance, and several other refinements.', 'zh': 'MacWhisper 14 延續這個方向，帶來全新設計的編輯器、更快的效能，以及多項其他優化。'}

{'text': 'Here’s Bruin on what’s new in this update:', 'zh': '以下是 Bruin 對今次更新的介紹：'}

{'text': 'Per Bruin, MacWhisper 14.1 has already launched based on early user feedback, with a number of refinements and fixes to the new editor. Version 14.1 also adds Gladia as a new cloud transcription provider, letting users transcribe using their own Gladia API keys.', 'zh': 'Bruin 表示，根據早期用戶意見，MacWhisper 14.1 已經率先推出，修正並優化了新編輯器的多項細節。14.1 版本亦加入 Gladia 作為全新的雲端轉錄服務供應商，用戶可透過自己的 Gladia API 密鑰進行轉錄。'}

{'text': 'MacWhisper 14 also includes:', 'zh': 'MacWhisper 14 同時包括：'}

{'text': 'A redesigned and clearer AI services screen; updated AI models from leading providers; a better playback experience when multiple transcripts are open at once; improvements to the transcript window, including better Cmd+A selection behavior and live editing interaction; Deepgram improvements including EU/US region selection, filler word controls, and expanded language support for Nova 3; cloud transcription uploads no longer load entire files into memory; and fixes for menu bar positioning, audio/video drag syncing, idle CPU usage, and edge cases for meeting recordings.', 'zh': '重新設計、更清晰易用的 AI 服務畫面；更新主流供應商的 AI 模型；同時開啟多份逐字稿時的播放體驗更出色；改進逐字稿視窗，包括更佳的 Cmd+A 選取表現以及即時編輯互動；Deepgram 方面亦有改進，包括歐盟／美國地區選擇、口頭禪控制，以及擴充 Nova 3 的語言支援；雲端轉錄上載不再將整個檔案載入記憶體；修正選單列位置、音訊／影片拖動同步、閒置時的 CPU 使用量，以及會議錄音的邊緣情況等問題。'}

{'text': 'MacWhisper Pro users can upgrade to version 14 for free. Bruin is also currently offering a 14% discount for users looking to upgrade to Pro.', 'zh': 'MacWhisper Pro 用戶可免費升級至 14 版本。Bruin 目前亦為有意升級至 Pro 的用戶提供 14% 折扣優惠。'}

{'text': 'Learn more about what’s new in MacWhisper 14 here.', 'zh': '想了解更多 MacWhisper 14 的新功能，請按此連結。'}
